findings.summary: Configurable-software studies show that many distinct configuration values can collapse into much smaller behavioral equivalence classes. The current five prospectively factorized width/height/receptor_rows settings collapse to one realized topology signature on the integrated v0.5 path, so these fields are currently non-operative with respect to topology construction rather than evidence of a new architecture mechanism.
sources: Reisner et al., Using Symbolic Evaluation to Understand Behavior in Configurable Software Systems, ICSE 2010, DOI 10.1145/1806799.1806864
Raue et al., Structural and practical identifiability analysis, Bioinformatics 2009, DOI 10.1093/bioinformatics/btp358

findings.summary: Misconfiguration research treats configuration as a first-class interface and identifies silent failures/error-prone constraints as ordinary system-design problems. Accepting and persisting non-default geometry-like values while the runtime ignores them and emits no warning is therefore naturally reduced to configuration validation/contract semantics.
sources: Xu et al., Do Not Blame Users for Misconfigurations, SOSP 2013, DOI 10.1145/2517349.2522727

findings.summary: Configuration-option effects and interactions are a mature testing problem. The current baseline plus width-only, height-only, receptor-only and combined matrix already provides a bounded factorized check; because all five map to one topology signature and source localization is explicit, expanding the same object would mainly re-measure the same omission. Fresh interaction testing is appropriate only after an intentional operative binding exists.
sources: Luo et al., AutoCCAG, ICSE 2021, DOI 10.1109/ICSE43902.2021.00030

findings.summary: Reproducibility literature stresses robust reporting and experiment context; 2026 ML logging research reports practitioner concern about missing hyperparameter/context logging. Inference for SparkBrain: faithfully persisting declared geometry values is not sufficient if those values do not govern the realized topology; checkpoint semantics should make compatibility-only or operative binding explicit.
sources: Pineau et al., Improving Reproducibility in Machine Learning Research, JMLR 2021
Foalem et al., Empirical Characterization of Logging Smells in Machine Learning Code, arXiv:2603.23769, 2026 preprint
